headline: Software engineer and lead architect — health-tech, AI and privacy.
intro: I've spent eleven years taking products from a first idea to something people rely on, most recently as founding engineer on two health-tech platforms at University College Cork.

I treat privacy and governance as part of the engineering, not paperwork afterwards. That matters more as AI moves into places where people are vulnerable. I now do this work independently, through rdelune.

roles.title: Founder
roles.summary: I help founders and product teams get their architecture, privacy and EU AI Act readiness right before they launch, scale or raise.
highlights: Technical consultancy to Karenua, the CommPAL spin-out, through its infrastructure and platform handover.

roles.title: Founding engineer & technical lead
roles.context: AI decision support for palliative-care triage and nurse caseload planning. Spun out as Karenua in 2026.
roles.summary: I designed the architecture and led delivery across the clinical web app, the data platform, model integration and the AWS infrastructure.
highlights: A regional data lake fed by automated hospital pipelines, with validation built in and patient identifiers hashed one-way.
Partner data processed inside Australia on temporary infrastructure, torn down after each run, with only anonymised findings coming back.
Agreeing data specifications with hospitals, clinicians, ethics and procurement before any patient data moved.

roles.title: Founding engineer & technical lead
roles.context: A digital harm-reduction service for university students.
roles.summary: I took it from research outlines to a live service with more than 10,000 registered students, working alongside psychologists and researchers.
highlights: Anonymous by design: returning students recover their session with a code only they hold, so nothing links them to a name or student record.
A content system that lets the research team change the intervention without a developer.
Chosen in 2025 as the digital tool for a Department of Health-funded programme bringing it to six Irish higher-education institutions.

roles.summary: Taught Programming for Web Applications and Services 1 & 2 on the MSc in Design and Development of Digital Business.

roles.title: Full-stack developer
roles.summary: Helped rebuild QuickMinutes, a commercial SaaS product, and built a Python oracle node for the Wagerr blockchain.

roles.title: Lead iOS developer
roles.summary: Led more than ten iOS apps for assistive technology used by people with severe disabilities.

roles.title: Software developer
